core_obligations: Show that the localized classes are defined: write Z locally as V(f_1, ..., f_r) for a regular sequence, use the Koszul resolution to see that F = i_* O_Z is perfect with zero restriction off Z, and invoke the quasi-compactness assumption (proof lines 12630-12648).

Set up the blowing up b : W -> P^1_X in infinity(Z), the closed immersion i' : P^1_Z -> W, and verify that Q = i'_* O_{P^1_Z} is perfect and that F and Q satisfy the hypotheses of Lemma labelled lemma-independent-loc-chern-bQ, using the explicit complete-intersection charts (proof lines 12650-12698).

Transport the assertion to the fiber case: use the defining property of the localized classes, identify Q|_E with the pushforward of O_Z, apply Lemma labelled lemma-compute-section, and match c(Z -> X, N) through its characterisation by j^* o C = p^* o c(Z -> X, N) (proof lines 12700-12705).
proof_roadmap: Make the statement meaningful via the Koszul resolution and perfection of i_* O_Z (proof lines 12630-12648).
Construct the blowing up and the closed immersion i' (proof lines 12650-12662).
Prove the claim that Q is perfect and that F and Q meet the hypotheses, via the complete-intersection charts (proof lines 12664-12698).
Reduce the statement to Lemma labelled lemma-compute-section and identify the class of the normal sheaf (proof lines 12700-12705).
difficulty_reason: For a regular closed immersion i : Z -> X of codimension r between schemes locally of finite type over a base (S, delta) as in Situation labelled situation-setup, the lemma states that c_t(Z -> X, i_* O_Z) = 0 for t = 1, ..., r - 1 and that c_r(Z -> X, i_* O_Z) = (-1)^{r - 1} (r - 1)! c(Z -> X, N) in A^r(Z -> X), where N is the conormal sheaf of Z in X and the c_t are the localized Chern classes of Definition labelled definition-localized-chern (statement lines 12612-12628). The proof begins by making the statement meaningful: locally on X one writes Z as V(f_1, ..., f_r) for a regular sequence, the Koszul complex is a resolution of A/(f_1, ..., f_r) by More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-regular-koszul-regular, hence F = i_* O_Z is a perfect object of D(O_X) with zero restriction off Z, so the localized classes exist under the quasi-compactness assumption (proof lines 12630-12648). The main body uses the blowing up b : W -> P^1_X in infinity(Z): the closed immersion i' : P^1_Z -> W is shown to give a perfect Q = i'_* O_{P^1_Z}, the claim that F and Q satisfy the hypotheses of Lemma labelled lemma-independent-loc-chern-bQ is proved by exhibiting the r + 1 affine charts of the blowing up as global complete intersections and reading off the regular sequence y_1, ..., y_r, sy_1 - f_1, ..., sy_r - f_r (proof lines 12650-12698). Granting the claim, the defining property of the localized classes in Lemma labelled lemma-independent-loc-chern-bQ converts the assertion into the corresponding one for c'_p(Q|_E), which is Lemma labelled lemma-compute-section, and the identification of c(Z -> X, N) via j^* o C = p^* o c(Z -> X, N) finishes the comparison (proof lines 12700-12705). The author marks one step of the regularity verification with 'Some details omitted' (proof line 12700) while the complete-intersection computation around it is written out. Recognising that the blown-up situation reduces the local statement to the fiber case handled by Lemma labelled lemma-compute-section is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
